snippet.title: Guns and Nuns: Storming Hell - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3818000/Guns_and_Nuns_Storming_Hell/

Guns and Nuns is an old school FPS where you play as the nun Angelica Amadeus, storming hell for fun with two golden desert eagles, destroying demons with the power of faith and hot lead through strange stages with bizarre gravity fields.

Your goal is to slay as many demons as possible before the timer runs out. You can extend the timer by breaking hourglasses scattered throughout each stage.

Slaying demons quickly starts a combo chain: the higher the combo, the higher the score. Slaying demons quickly enough makes the nun enter in "Holy Time" mode, making her a psychopath, her guns stronger and allowing you gain bonus points during that state.

The game features:
1- Unique gravity system that creates unique maps to explore.
2- Pure arcade fun, no ammo or complex story, just gameplay.
3- Seven bizarre environments, each inspired by a deadly sin.
4- Unique set of enemies per map.
5- Great melodic rock music for each stage.
6- Deliver immaculate damage and pain to demons.
7- Low poly aesthetic.
8- Seven weapons to try out and have fun with.
9- You play as Angelica Amadeus.
